description: Cryptographic modules are not FIPS 140-2/140-3 validated when protecting CUI. This signal indicates that cryptographic implementations may not meet federal security standards.
applicability: Applicable to all cryptographic protection of CUI. Includes encryption modules, key management systems, and cryptographic libraries used for CUI protection.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through cryptographic module validation verification, FIPS mode configuration review, and encryption library assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
